posts.title: Knitlog [2026-11-16 Mon]
posts.description: Clara Ballet Slippers Test Crochet Initially planning to use up my white handspun yarn: First skein of yarn: 17g Second skein: 19g 2.7g = 4m, so I have total apprx. 53m So it’s not enough. Sigh… Eventually I decided to use the stash yarn from Sirona Sweater. This forest green is an odd choice for ballet slippers but whatever. I think it would pair nicely with the crocheted lace details though.

posts.title: Knitlog [2026-11-14 Sat]
posts.description: Laid Edges Socks Cast on a new pair of socks today - Laid Edges by Kellie Macpherson. I mainly want to test the cashmere sock yarn I recently bought on Taobao and see how it knits up. The seller says it’s over 85% cashmere, but I’m pretty sure that number is a bit exaggerated… Anyways, it does feel really soft, so that’s a good start.
